name: manual_afb344
claim: Explicit, dated, human-authorized exception to RED-first TDD for the remaining PR3 (coordination-bias-detector) findings in the endpoint-policy/tri-stack standardization effort, active from 2026-08-23. Scope is narrow and does not relax TDD as a general practice: only the still-open bias_detector.py findings (wrong event_type query target, missing word-boundary in substring confidence matching, incorrect variance metric for agreement_collapse, N+1 query pattern reading the full table then discarding via LIMIT in Python, and the dead agent_outputs parameter) may be fixed without RED-first tests. Fix only, commit in logical batches (one concern per commit, matching the discipline already used for PR1 and PR2 in this same stacked-PR effort), and push -- but proper RED-first regression tests for these specific fixes must be written and added by Thursday, 2026-08-27 (4 days from the exception's start date), before this work is considered complete. This does not apply to any other file, PR, or future work in this repo; the standing docs/TDD.md policy resumes immediately once these PR3 fixes are committed. The repo's own scripts/git/check_tdd_commit.sh gate is scoped only to web/src/*.ts(x) and never technically fires for Python files like bias_detector.py, so this exception isn't mechanically enforced either way here -- but its established `tdd-skip: <reason>` commit-message convention is followed in spirit for these commits, matching the documented policy in docs/TDD.md rather than inventing an ad-hoc format.

decisions.notes: Explicit, direct human authorization to skip TDD rigor for PR3's remaining findings, with a concrete backfill deadline (Thursday 2026-08-27) -- recorded so this documented exception, not an unexplained departure from established discipline, is on record for resumption.
